
```{r, include=FALSE}
# =============================================================================
# CPA SUBSECTION (child of adu_permit_pipeline.Rmd). Called once per CPA with
# this_cpa set. Outputs, in order: tract outline map, land use summary, eligible
# lots map; ADU units by status, ADUs by property type, two cumulative charts,
# ADU projects map; community profile, four tract maps, the layered tract map;
# working-class demographics and ADU tables.
# =============================================================================
cc <- this_cpa
bd <- filter(cpa_sf, cpa == cc)
xw_cc <- tract_xwalk %>% filter(cpa == cc)
tr_cc <- tracts_sf %>% filter(CT20 %in% xw_cc$CT20)
tr_clip <- st_intersection(tr_cc, st_geometry(bd)) %>% st_collection_extract("POLYGON") %>%
  group_by(CT20, LABEL) %>% summarise(.groups = "drop")
ls_cc <- land_tbl %>% filter(cpa == cc)
as_cc <- adu_tbl %>% filter(cpa == cc)
a_cc  <- adu_focus %>% filter(cpa == cc)
p_cc  <- prop_sf %>% filter(cpa == cc)
older_cc <- sum(p_cc$older_adu, na.rm = TRUE)
id <- gsub("[^a-z]", "", tolower(cc))
```

## `r cc`

```{r, results='asis'}

            cc, fmt(ls_cc$r1), fmt(ls_cc$r2), fmt(ls_cc$r8), window_label, fmt(as_cc$projects), fmt(as_cc$units),
            pct(as_cc$completed / as_cc$units), nrow(xw_cc),
            fmt(acs_cpa$estimate[acs_cpa$cpa == cc & acs_cpa$measure == "Total population"])))
```

### Land use

```{r, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=7.5}
# ---- Tract outline map: the CPA and its tracts -----------------------------------------------
outside <- st_difference(st_union(tr_cc), st_union(bd))
hatch <- hatch_lines(outside, n = 90)
frame_geom <- st_union(c(st_geometry(tr_cc), st_geometry(bd)))
neighbors <- cpa_sf %>% filter(cpa != cc) %>% st_filter(st_buffer(frame_geom, 3000))
bm <- bm_for(frame_geom, tiles = 4)
bbm <- st_bbox(st_transform(st_buffer(frame_geom, 1500), crs_map))
g <- ggplot() +
  basemap_layer(bm, fade = 0.35) +
  geom_sf(data = st_transform(neighbors, crs_map), fill = NA, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_sf_text(data = st_transform(st_point_on_surface(neighbors), crs_map), aes(label = cpa), size = 2.3, color = "grey55") +
  geom_sf(data = st_transform(tr_cc, crs_map), fill = NA, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.25) +
  { if (length(hatch)) geom_sf(data = st_transform(hatch, crs_map), color = "#7A5C00", linewidth = 0.2) } +
  geom_sf(data = st_transform(bd, crs_map), fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1.1) +
  coord_sf(crs = crs_map, xlim = c(bbm[["xmin"]], bbm[["xmax"]]), ylim = c(bbm[["ymin"]], bbm[["ymax"]]), expand = FALSE, datum = NA) +
  labs(title = paste0(cc, " and its census tracts"),
       subtitle = sprintf("%d census tracts · %s sq ft (%s sq mi)", nrow(xw_cc), fmt(ls_cc$area_sqft), fmt(ls_cc$area_sqft / 27878400, 2)),
       caption = paste0("Bold line: CPA boundary. Thin lines: tracts with at least 50% of their land in the CPA.\nHatching: tract land outside the CPA (ACS data describe whole tracts). Dashed: neighboring CPAs.\n2020 census tracts (LA County eGIS); CPAs (City Planning).\n", basemap_credit)) +
  theme_void() + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0))
print(g)
qa_add(7, paste0("Tract outline map has tracts, ", cc), ">0", nrow(tr_cc), nrow(tr_cc) > 0, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ---- Eligible lots map: where the eligible lots are -----------------------------------------
lots <- p_cc %>% filter(eligA) %>% select(AIN, is_sf, is_mf, hillside_fire, ct20) %>%
  st_simplify(preserveTopology = TRUE, dTolerance = 5)   # simplified before embedding
n_vert <- sum(vapply(st_geometry(lots), function(gm) nrow(st_coordinates(gm)), 1L))
est_mb <- (n_vert * 20 + nrow(lots) * 40) / 1e6   # 5-decimal coordinates: about 20 bytes a vertex in the page
use_points <- est_mb > 8          # size budget: points if the polygons would exceed ~8 MB
if (use_points) lots <- st_point_on_surface(lots)
lots_ll <- to_ll(lots, digits = 5)
grp_sets <- list(sf_keep = lots_ll$is_sf & !lots_ll$hillside_fire, sf_flag = lots_ll$is_sf & lots_ll$hillside_fire,
                 mf_keep = lots_ll$is_mf & !lots_ll$hillside_fire, mf_flag = lots_ll$is_mf & lots_ll$hillside_fire)
col_sf <- "#3A6EA5"; col_mf <- "#8E5BB5"; col_rm <- "#7F7F7F"
tcount <- st_drop_geometry(p_cc) %>% group_by(ct20) %>%
  summarise(total = n(), sf_A = sum(sfA), sf_B = sum(sfB), all_A = sum(eligA), all_B = sum(eligB), .groups = "drop")
tr_l3 <- tr_clip %>% left_join(tcount, by = c("CT20" = "ct20")) %>% mutate(across(c(total, sf_A, sf_B, all_A, all_B), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L)))
tr_l3_ll <- to_ll(tr_l3); tr_pts_ll <- to_ll(st_point_on_surface(tr_l3))
pal_tr <- colorNumeric("Greens", domain = c(0, max(c(tr_l3$sf_A, tr_l3$all_A), 1)))
views <- list(sf_A = c("sf_keep", "sf_flag", "tr_sf_A"), sf_B = c("sf_keep", "sf_flag_rm", "tr_sf_B"),
              all_A = c("sf_keep", "sf_flag", "mf_keep", "mf_flag", "tr_all_A"),
              all_B = c("sf_keep", "sf_flag_rm", "mf_keep", "mf_flag_rm", "tr_all_B"))
add_lots <- function(m, sel, grp, color, removed = FALSE) {
  if (!any(sel)) return(m)
  d <- lots_ll[sel, ]
  if (use_points) {
    addCircleMarkers(m, data = d, radius = 2, stroke = removed, color = color, weight = 1, fill = !removed,
                     fillColor = color, fillOpacity = 0.7, group = grp)
  } else {
    addPolygons(m, data = d, weight = if (removed) 0.8 else 0.3, color = color, opacity = 0.9,
                fill = !removed, fillColor = color, fillOpacity = 0.55, group = grp)
  }
}
m <- leaflet_base(bm_key = cpa_key(cc)) %>% fit_to(bd) %>%
  addPolygons(data = to_ll(bd), fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 2.5,
              options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE))   # outline only: hover reaches the layer below
for (v in c("sf_A", "sf_B", "all_A", "all_B")) {
  lab <- sprintf("<b>Tract %s</b><br>Eligible lots in this view: %s<br>Total parcels: %s<br>Share eligible: %s",
                 tr_l3_ll$LABEL, fmt(tr_l3_ll[[v]]), fmt(tr_l3_ll$total), pct(tr_l3_ll[[v]] / pmax(tr_l3_ll$total, 1)))
  m <- m %>%
    addPolygons(data = tr_l3_ll, fillColor = pal_tr(tr_l3_ll[[v]]), fillOpacity = 0.35, color = "#444444", weight = 0.8,
                label = lapply(lab, HTML), group = paste0("tr_", v)) %>%
    addLabelOnlyMarkers(data = tr_pts_ll, label = fmt(tr_pts_ll[[v]]), group = paste0("tr_", v),
                        labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, direction = "center", style = label_style))
}
m <- m %>%
  add_lots(grp_sets$sf_keep, "sf_keep", col_sf) %>% add_lots(grp_sets$sf_flag, "sf_flag", col_sf) %>%
  add_lots(grp_sets$sf_flag, "sf_flag_rm", col_rm, removed = TRUE) %>%
  add_lots(grp_sets$mf_keep, "mf_keep", col_mf) %>% add_lots(grp_sets$mf_flag, "mf_flag", col_mf) %>%
  add_lots(grp_sets$mf_flag, "mf_flag_rm", col_rm, removed = TRUE) %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", colors = c(col_sf, col_mf, col_rm),
            labels = c("Eligible single-family lot", "Eligible multi-family lot", "Removed in tier B (outline)"), opacity = 0.8) %>%
  onRender("
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this, nm = el.id;
      var ctrl = L.control({position: 'topright'});
      ctrl.onAdd = function() {
        var div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'leaflet-bar');
        div.style.background = 'white'; div.style.padding = '6px 8px'; div.style.fontSize = '12px';
        div.innerHTML = '<b>Property type</b><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_pt\" value=\"sf\" checked> Single-family</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_pt\" value=\"all\"> All eligible</label><br>' +
          '<b>Screen</b><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_sc\" value=\"A\" checked> Tier A (size)</label><br>' +
          '<label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"' + nm + '_sc\" value=\"B\"> Tier B (size + hillside-fire)</label>';
        L.DomEvent.disableClickPropagation(div);
        return div;
      };
      ctrl.addTo(map);
      function update() {
        var pt = el.querySelector('input[name=\"' + nm + '_pt\"]:checked').value;
        var sc = el.querySelector('input[name=\"' + nm + '_sc\"]:checked').value;
        var show = data.views[pt + '_' + sc];
        data.groups.forEach(function(g) {
          var lg = map.layerManager.getLayerGroup(g, false);
          if (!lg) return;
          if (show.indexOf(g) >= 0) { if (!map.hasLayer(lg)) map.addLayer(lg); } else { map.removeLayer(lg); }
        });
      }
      el.addEventListener('change', update);
      update();
    }", data = list(views = views,
                    groups = c("sf_keep", "sf_flag", "sf_flag_rm", "mf_keep", "mf_flag", "mf_flag_rm",
                               "tr_sf_A", "tr_sf_B", "tr_all_A", "tr_all_B")))
qa_add(7, paste0("Eligible lots map has lots, ", cc), ">0", fmt(nrow(lots)), nrow(lots) > 0, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
tagList(tags$p(tags$b(paste0("Eligible lots, ", cc))), m,
        tags$p(style = "font-size: 12px;",
               paste0("Use the controls to switch property type and screen; in tier B, lots the hillside-fire screen removes are grey outlines. Tracts (clipped to the CPA) are shaded by eligible lots in the current view, with the count printed; where counts overlap, zoom in or hover. Lots drawn as ",
                      if (use_points) "points (size budget)" else "simplified parcel outlines", ". ", basemap_credit, ".")))
```

### ADUs

```{r}
# ---- ADU units by status ---------------------------------------------------
s <- as_cc
qa_add(7, paste0("ADU units by status: completed + in progress + stalled = total units, ", cc), fmt(s$units),
       fmt(s$completed + s$in_progress + s$stalled), s$completed + s$in_progress + s$stalled == s$units, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(7, paste0("ADU units by status: the CPA has ADU units, ", cc), ">0", fmt(s$units), s$units > 0, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
tibble(Row = c(paste0("Total ADU units, ", window_label), "Completed", "In progress", "Stalled",
               "Outside tier A: units on single-family or multi-family lots under 4,500 sq ft",
               "Outside tier B: units on single-family or multi-family lots under 4,500 sq ft, or on any lot flagged hillside-fire"),
       `ADU units` = fmt(c(s$units, s$completed, s$in_progress, s$stalled, s$outside_A, s$outside_B)),
       `Share of total` = pct(c(s$units, s$completed, s$in_progress, s$stalled, s$outside_A, s$outside_B) / s$units)) %>%
  tbl(caption = paste0("ADU units by status, ", cc, " (ADU units)"),
      note = paste0(fmt(s$projects), " ADU projects. Projects are placed by their parcel's location. Status: completed = CofO, final inspection or CofC anywhere in the permit chain; stalled = no change in permit status since ",
                    format(stall_cutoff, "%B %e, %Y") %>% str_squish(), " (three years or more); in progress = all other active projects. The two \"outside\" rows are already counted in the total and status rows."))
```

**Older or unpermitted ADUs (separate count):** `r fmt(older_cc)` single-family parcels in `r cc` carry an Assessor use code recording an ADU but hold no permitted ADU project from `r window_label`. Each counts as one ADU here and is never added to the permitted units above. The roll lags construction and the code does not say whether a unit was permitted, so this is an indicator, not a count of unpermitted units.

```{r}
# ---- Properties with ADUs, then unit status by property type --------------
other_props <- s$properties - s$prop_sf - s$prop_mf
qa_add(7, paste0("ADUs by property type: property rows sum to the total, ", cc), fmt(s$properties), fmt(s$prop_sf + s$prop_mf + other_props),
       other_props >= 0, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
units_by <- function(d) c(sum(d$units), sum(d$units[d$status == "Completed"]),
                          sum(d$units[d$status == "In progress"]), sum(d$units[d$status == "Stalled"]))
u_sf <- units_by(filter(a_cc, property_type == "Single-family")); u_mf <- units_by(filter(a_cc, property_type == "Multi-family"))
u_ot <- units_by(filter(a_cc, !property_type %in% c("Single-family", "Multi-family"))); u_all <- units_by(a_cc)
for (nm in c("single-family", "multi-family")) {
  v <- if (nm == "single-family") u_sf else u_mf
  qa_add(7, paste0("ADUs by property type: ", nm, " status columns sum to the units, ", cc), fmt(v[1]), fmt(sum(v[-1])), sum(v[-1]) == v[1], stop_if_fail = TRUE)
}
qa_add(7, paste0("ADUs by property type: unit rows sum to the status table total, by status, ", cc), paste(fmt(u_all), collapse = " / "),
       paste(fmt(u_sf + u_mf + u_ot), collapse = " / "),
       all(u_sf + u_mf + u_ot == u_all) && all(u_all == c(s$units, s$completed, s$in_progress, s$stalled)), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
a2 <- rbind(u_all, u_sf, u_mf, u_ot)
props <- c(s$properties, s$prop_sf, s$prop_mf, other_props)
tibble(`Property type` = c("All properties with ADUs", "Single-family properties", "Multi-family properties", "Other or unknown"),
       `Properties with ADUs` = fmt(props), `Share of properties` = pct(props / s$properties),
       `ADU units` = fmt(a2[, 1]), Completed = fmt(a2[, 2]), `In progress` = fmt(a2[, 3]), Stalled = fmt(a2[, 4]),
       `Share completed` = ifelse(a2[, 1] > 0, pct(a2[, 2] / pmax(a2[, 1], 1)), "n/a")) %>%
  tbl(caption = paste0("Properties with ADUs and ADU units by status, by property type, ", cc),
      note = "Properties are parcels with at least one ADU project; the unit columns count ADU units on those properties, and completed + in progress + stalled = ADU units. Property type is the parcel's land use class from the 2026 roll (the same source as the lot counts), so it reflects use in 2026, not at the permit date. Other or unknown: other parcel classes, plus projects placed on no parcel (each counted once); for those, a permit sub-type of Apartment counts as multi-family.",
      align = c("l", rep("r", 7)))
```

```{r}
# ---- Cumulative units by year, with a year slider ------------------
ch_sf <- dated_chart(a_cc %>% filter(property_type == "Single-family"),
                     paste0("Cumulative ADU units by year, single-family properties, ", cc))
ch_mf <- dated_chart(a_cc %>% filter(property_type == "Multi-family"),
                     paste0("Cumulative ADU units by year, multi-family properties, ", cc))
for (tp in c("Single-family", "Multi-family")) {      # reconciliation with the property-type table
  bars <- if (tp == "Single-family") ch_sf$bars else ch_mf$bars
  last <- bars[bars$year == max(bars$year), ]
  d <- a_cc %>% filter(property_type == tp)
  ok <- last$Completed == sum(d$units[d$status == "Completed"]) &&
    last$New + last$Ongoing == sum(d$units[d$status %in% c("In progress", "Stalled")])
  qa_add(7, paste0("Cumulative charts reconciliation, ", tolower(tp), ", ", cc, ": last bar matches the property-type table"),
         "matches", if (ok) "matches" else "differs", ok, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
}
chart_notes <- tags$ul(style = "font-size: 12px;",
  tags$li(sprintf("Each bar is every ADU unit submitted by the end of that year, so the bars accumulate. Completed: completion date on or before December 31 (CofO date; else the date of the CofO, final-inspection or CofC status). New: first submitted that year and not completed by its end. Ongoing: submitted earlier and not completed by its end. %s* runs to %s.",
                  year(data_asof), format(data_asof, "%B %e") %>% str_squish())),
  tags$li("Projects later dropped as not active never appear, so earlier bars show only projects that are alive or completed today."),
  tags$li("Stalled cannot be shown for past years: the extracts keep only each permit's latest status date."),
  tags$li(sprintf("Permits submitted but not issued by %s are not in the data. Submitted = the earliest SUBMITTED_DATE in the chain (the issue date where it is blank); projects submitted before 2017 enter the 2017 bar as ongoing.",
                  format(data_asof, "%B %e, %Y") %>% str_squish())))
tagList(ch_sf$widget, ch_mf$widget, chart_notes)
```

```{r}
# ---- ADU projects map: where the ADUs are ----------------------------------------------------
pts_cc <- adu_pts %>% filter(cpa == cc) %>% to_ll()
tstat <- a_cc %>% group_by(ct20) %>%
  summarise(comp = sum(units[status == "Completed"]), prog = sum(units[status == "In progress"]),
            stal = sum(units[status == "Stalled"]), units = sum(units), .groups = "drop")   # total last
oc <- older_counts %>% filter(cpa == cc) %>% select(ct20, older = older_adu)
tr_a5 <- tr_clip %>% left_join(tstat, by = c("CT20" = "ct20")) %>% left_join(oc, by = c("CT20" = "ct20")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(units, comp, prog, stal, older), ~ coalesce(as.numeric(.x), 0)))
tr_a5_ll <- to_ll(tr_a5); tp_ll <- to_ll(st_point_on_surface(tr_a5))
cls5 <- tract_class$class[match(tr_a5_ll$CT20, tract_class$CT20)]      # class under the rule A + B + C
qa_add(7, paste0("ADU projects map: every tract has a class for the working-class overlay, ", cc), nrow(tr_a5_ll),
       sum(cls5 %in% names(wc_cols)), all(cls5 %in% names(wc_cols)), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
lab5 <- sprintf("<b>Tract %s</b><br>ADU units: %s<br>Completed: %s<br>In progress: %s<br>Stalled: %s<br>Older or unpermitted ADUs (separate): %s<br>Tract class (A + B + C): %s",
                tr_a5_ll$LABEL, fmt(tr_a5_ll$units), fmt(tr_a5_ll$comp), fmt(tr_a5_ll$prog), fmt(tr_a5_ll$stal), fmt(tr_a5_ll$older), cls5)
g_wc5 <- "Working-class tracts (A + B + C)"
m5 <- leaflet_base(bm_key = cpa_key(cc)) %>% fit_to(bd) %>%
  addMapPane("wcTracts", zIndex = 350) %>%     # below the project dots, above the basemap
  addPolygons(data = tr_a5_ll, fillColor = wc_pal(cls5), fillOpacity = 0.55, color = "#FFFFFF", weight = 0.3, group = g_wc5,
              options = pathOptions(pane = "wcTracts", interactive = FALSE)) %>%
  addPolygons(data = tr_a5_ll, fill = TRUE, fillColor = "#FFFFFF", fillOpacity = 0.15, color = "#555555", weight = 0.8,
              label = lapply(lab5, HTML)) %>%
  addLabelOnlyMarkers(data = tp_ll, label = fmt(tp_ll$units),
                      labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, direction = "center", style = label_style)) %>%
  addPolygons(data = to_ll(bd), fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 2.5,
              options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE))   # outline only: hover reaches the layer below
for (stt in status_levels) {
  d <- pts_cc %>% filter(status == stt)
  if (nrow(d)) m5 <- m5 %>%
    addCircleMarkers(data = d, radius = 1.6 + 1.1 * sqrt(d$units), stroke = TRUE, color = "#333333", weight = 0.3,
                     fillColor = pal_status[[stt]], fillOpacity = 0.85, group = stt,
                     label = sprintf("%s: %s unit(s), issued %s", stt, d$units, d$issue_year))
}
m5 <- m5 %>%
  addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c(status_levels, g_wc5), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>%
  addLegend("bottomleft", colors = unname(wc_cols), labels = names(wc_cols), title = "Tract class (A + B + C)", opacity = 0.8, group = g_wc5) %>%
  hideGroup(g_wc5) %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", colors = unname(pal_status), labels = status_levels, title = "Status", opacity = 0.9)
qa_add(7, paste0("ADU projects map has project points, ", cc), ">0", fmt(nrow(pts_cc)), nrow(pts_cc) > 0, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
n_out_tr <- sum(a_cc$units[!(a_cc$ct20 %in% xw_cc$CT20)])
tagList(tags$p(tags$b(paste0("ADU projects by status, ", cc))), m5,
        tags$p(style = "font-size: 12px;",
               paste0("One point per project at its parcel, sized by units; tick boxes to show or hide a status. Tick \"Working-class tracts (A + B + C)\" to shade the tracts by their class under the rule used in this analysis (working-class, other, or insufficient data). Tracts (clipped to the CPA) show total ADU units; hover for the status split, the separate count of older or unpermitted ADUs and the tract class.",
                      if (n_out_tr > 0) sprintf(" %s units sit on parcels in the CPA whose tract is assigned to another CPA; they count in the CPA totals but in no tract here.", fmt(n_out_tr)) else "",
                      " ", basemap_credit, ".")))
```

```{r}
# ---- Four tract maps ---------------------------------------------------------
tr_full <- tracts_sf %>% filter(CT20 %in% xw_cc$CT20) %>% left_join(d2_tract, by = "GEOID") %>% to_ll()
mk_rate_map <- function(var, title) {
  num <- tr_full[[paste0(var, "_num")]]; den <- tr_full[[paste0(var, "_den")]]
  est <- tr_full[[paste0(var, "_est")]]; moe <- tr_full[[paste0(var, "_moe")]]; grey <- tr_full[[paste0(var, "_grey")]]
  fill <- ifelse(grey, "#D9D9D9", d2_pal[[var]](est))
  lab <- sprintf("<b>Tract %s</b><br>%s: %s<br>%s of %s households%s", tr_full$LABEL, title,
                 ifelse(is.na(est), "n/a", paste0(fmt(100 * est, 1), "% ± ", fmt(100 * moe, 1))),
                 fmt(num), fmt(den), ifelse(grey, "<br><i>Greyed: under 50 households in the group, or low reliability</i>", ""))
  leaflet_base(height = 380, bm_key = cpa_key(cc)) %>% fit_to(tr_cc) %>%
    addPolygons(data = tr_full, fillColor = fill, fillOpacity = 0.75, color = "#444444", weight = 0.6, label = lapply(lab, HTML)) %>%
    addPolygons(data = to_ll(bd), fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 2.5,
              options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE)) %>%   # outline only: hover reaches the layer below
    addLegend("bottomright", pal = d2_pal[[var]], values = d2_domain[[var]], title = "Rate", opacity = 0.8,
              labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = "%", transform = function(x) round(100 * x)))
}
wc_map <- function() {
  cls <- tr_full$class_lab
  leaflet_base(height = 380, bm_key = cpa_key(cc)) %>% fit_to(tr_cc) %>%
    addPolygons(data = tr_full, fillColor = wc_pal(cls), fillOpacity = 0.75, color = "#444444", weight = 0.6,
                label = lapply(wc_hover(tr_full, cls = cls), HTML)) %>%
    addPolygons(data = to_ll(bd), fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 2.5,
              options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE)) %>%   # outline only: hover reaches the layer below
    addLegend("bottomright", colors = wc_cols, labels = names(wc_cols), opacity = 0.8)
}
cell <- function(title, w) tags$div(style = "width: 49%; display: inline-block; vertical-align: top; margin-bottom: 8px;",
                                    tags$div(style = "font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px;", title), w)
qa_add(7, paste0("Tract maps have tracts, ", cc), nrow(xw_cc), nrow(tr_full), nrow(tr_full) == nrow(xw_cc), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
tagList(
  tags$p(tags$b(paste0("Tract maps, ", cc))),
  cell("Homeownership rate", mk_rate_map("own", "Homeownership")),
  cell("Black homeownership rate", mk_rate_map("blk", "Black homeownership")),
  cell("Latino homeownership rate", mk_rate_map("lat", "Latino homeownership")),
  cell("Working-class tracts", wc_map()),
  tags$p(style = "font-size: 12px;",
         paste0("Crosswalk tracts drawn in full (ACS describes whole tracts) with the CPA boundary on top. One color scale per measure, shared by all six CPAs. Hover for the rate ± margin of error, numerator and denominator; on the working-class map, hover for the three test values, each marked pass or fail. ",
                "Homeownership rate = B25038_002 ÷ B25038_001; Black = B25003B_002 ÷ B25003B_001; Latino = B25003I_002 ÷ B25003I_001. ",
                "Grey: the group has fewer than 50 households in the tract, or the rate is flagged low reliability (coefficient of variation over 30%). Working-class: tests A, B and C all pass; insufficient data: under 100 residents or no published median family income. ACS 2020–2024 5-year. ", basemap_credit, ".")))
```

```{r}
# ---- Layered tract map: homeowners by group, with ADUs on top ----------------------
ly <- tr_full %>% left_join(tstat, by = c("CT20" = "ct20")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(units, comp, prog, stal), ~ coalesce(as.numeric(.x), 0)))
hi_class <- function(g) {
  o <- ly$own_est >= lay_high; gg <- ly[[paste0(g, "_est")]] >= lay_high
  case_when(ly[[paste0(g, "_grey")]] | ly$own_grey ~ hh_levels[5], o & gg ~ hh_levels[1], o & !gg ~ hh_levels[2],
            !o & gg ~ hh_levels[3], TRUE ~ hh_levels[4])
}
ly$hi_lat <- hi_class("lat"); ly$hi_blk <- hi_class("blk")
adu_cut <- median(ly$units)                     # the middle tract of this CPA on ADU units
ly <- ly %>% mutate(many_adu = units >= adu_cut & units > 0,
                    focus_lat = hi_lat == hh_levels[1] & many_adu, focus_blk = hi_blk == hh_levels[1] & many_adu)
qa_add(7, paste0("Layered tract map has every tract, ", cc), nrow(xw_cc), nrow(ly), nrow(ly) == nrow(xw_cc), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(7, paste0("Layered tract map: ADU units by tract sum to the units in the CPA's tracts, ", cc),
       fmt(sum(a_cc$units[a_cc$ct20 %in% xw_cc$CT20])), fmt(sum(ly$units)),
       sum(ly$units) == sum(a_cc$units[a_cc$ct20 %in% xw_cc$CT20]), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
qa_add(7, paste0("Layered tract map: focus tracts all have both rates at 50% or more and ADU units at or above the CPA's middle tract, ", cc),
       "all", "checked",
       all(ly$own_est[ly$focus_lat | ly$focus_blk] >= 0.5) && all(ly$lat_est[ly$focus_lat] >= 0.5) &&
         all(ly$blk_est[ly$focus_blk] >= 0.5) && all(ly$units[ly$focus_lat | ly$focus_blk] >= adu_cut), stop_if_fail = TRUE)
nmv <- function(v) as.list(setNames(v, ly$GEOID))
ly_cols <- list(
  latn = nmv(lay_cnt_pal$lat(ly$lat_num)), blkn = nmv(lay_cnt_pal$blk(ly$blk_num)),
  own = nmv(ifelse(ly$own_grey, "#D9D9D9", d2_pal$own(ly$own_est))),
  lat = nmv(ifelse(ly$lat_grey, "#D9D9D9", d2_pal$lat(ly$lat_est))),
  blk = nmv(ifelse(ly$blk_grey, "#D9D9D9", d2_pal$blk(ly$blk_est))),
  hil = nmv(unname(hh_cols[ly$hi_lat])), hib = nmv(unname(hh_cols[ly$hi_blk])),
  wc = nmv(unname(wc_cols[as.character(ly$class_lab)])), none = nmv(rep("#FFFFFF", nrow(ly))))
ly_pr <- function(e, m, g) ifelse(is.na(e), "n/a", paste0(fmt(100 * e, 1), "% ± ", fmt(100 * m, 1), ifelse(g, " (few households or unreliable)", "")))
ly_hover <- sprintf(paste0("<b>Tract %s</b> · %s<br>",
                           "Households: %s · owners: %s · homeownership rate %s<br>",
                           "Latino households: %s · Latino owners: <b>%s</b> · rate %s<br>",
                           "Black households: %s · Black owners: <b>%s</b> · rate %s<br>",
                           "ADU units: <b>%s</b> (completed %s, in progress %s, stalled %s)%s"),
                    ly$LABEL, ly$class_lab, fmt(ly$own_den), fmt(ly$own_num), ly_pr(ly$own_est, ly$own_moe, ly$own_grey),
                    fmt(ly$lat_den), fmt(ly$lat_num), ly_pr(ly$lat_est, ly$lat_moe, ly$lat_grey),
                    fmt(ly$blk_den), fmt(ly$blk_num), ly_pr(ly$blk_est, ly$blk_moe, ly$blk_grey),
                    fmt(ly$units), fmt(ly$comp), fmt(ly$prog), fmt(ly$stal),
                    ifelse(ly$focus_lat | ly$focus_blk,
                           paste0("<br><i>Focus tract: homeownership and ",
                                  ifelse(ly$focus_lat & ly$focus_blk, "Latino and Black", ifelse(ly$focus_lat, "Latino", "Black")),
                                  " homeownership 50% or more, and ADU units at or above the CPA's middle tract</i>"), ""))
g_fl <- "Focus: Latino owners + ADUs"; g_fb <- "Focus: Black owners + ADUs"; g_n <- "ADU units per tract"
b_ly <- st_bbox(to_ll(bd)); ctr_ly <- suppressWarnings(st_point_on_surface(ly))
mL <- leaflet_base(height = 680, bm_key = cpa_key(cc)) %>%
  fitBounds(b_ly[["xmin"]], b_ly[["ymin"]], b_ly[["xmax"]], b_ly[["ymax"]], options = list(padding = c(25, 25))) %>%
  addPolygons(data = ly, layerId = ~GEOID, fillColor = unlist(ly_cols$latn, use.names = FALSE), fillOpacity = 0.72,
              color = "#555555", weight = 0.7, label = lapply(ly_hover, HTML)) %>%
  addPolygons(data = to_ll(bd), fill = FALSE, color = "black", weight = 2.5,
              options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE))   # outline only: hover reaches the layer below
if (any(ly$focus_lat)) mL <- mL %>%
  addPolygons(data = ly[ly$focus_lat, ], fill = FALSE, color = "#D7191C", weight = 3.5, group = g_fl,
              options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE))
if (any(ly$focus_blk)) mL <- mL %>%
  addPolygons(data = ly[ly$focus_blk, ], fill = FALSE, color = "#7B3294", weight = 3.5, dashArray = "6,4", group = g_fb,
              options = pathOptions(interactive = FALSE))
mL <- mL %>% addLabelOnlyMarkers(data = ctr_ly, label = fmt(ctr_ly$units), group = g_n,
                                 labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, direction = "center", style = label_style))
for (stt in status_levels) {
  dpt <- pts_cc %>% filter(status == stt)
  if (nrow(dpt)) mL <- mL %>%
    addCircleMarkers(data = dpt, radius = 1.6 + 1.1 * sqrt(dpt$units), stroke = TRUE, color = "#333333", weight = 0.3,
                     fillColor = pal_status[[stt]], fillOpacity = 0.85, group = paste0("ADUs: ", stt),
                     label = sprintf("%s: %s unit(s), issued %s", stt, dpt$units, dpt$issue_year))
}
ov_ly <- c(paste0("ADUs: ", status_levels[status_levels %in% pts_cc$status]), g_n,
           if (any(ly$focus_lat)) g_fl, if (any(ly$focus_blk)) g_fb)
mL <- mL %>%
  addLayersControl(overlayGroups = ov_ly, position = "topleft", options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>%
  hideGroup(g_n) %>%
  onRender(lay_js, data = list(cols = ly_cols, legends = lay_legends))
n_fl <- sum(ly$focus_lat); n_fb <- sum(ly$focus_blk)
tr_word <- function(n) if (n == 0) "no tracts" else if (n == 1) "1 tract" else paste(n, "tracts")
ly_tab <- ly %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% arrange(desc(lat_num + blk_num)) %>%
  transmute(Tract = LABEL, Class = as.character(class_lab), Households = fmt(own_den),
            `Homeownership rate` = ifelse(is.na(own_est), "n/a", paste0(fmt(100 * own_est, 1), "%")),
            `Latino owner households` = fmt(lat_num), `Latino homeownership rate` = ifelse(lat_grey, "few", paste0(fmt(100 * lat_est, 1), "%")),
            `Black owner households` = fmt(blk_num), `Black homeownership rate` = ifelse(blk_grey, "few", paste0(fmt(100 * blk_est, 1), "%")),
            `ADU units` = fmt(units),
            `Focus tract` = case_when(focus_lat & focus_blk ~ "Latino and Black", focus_lat ~ "Latino", focus_blk ~ "Black", TRUE ~ "")) %>%
  kable(format = "html", align = c("l", "l", rep("r", 7), "l")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12)
tagList(
  tags$p(tags$b(paste0("Homeowners and ADUs by tract, one layered map, ", cc))), mL,
  tags$p(style = "font-size: 12px;",
         paste0("Choose what the tracts are shaded by in the menu at top right; tick ADU layers and focus-tract outlines at top left; hover over a tract for every number at once. The map opens on Latino owner households with the ADU projects on top. ",
                "Counts are Latino or Black owner-occupied households in the tract (B25003I_002, B25003B_002). Rates are owner households ÷ households, for everyone and within each group; a group's rate is grey where the group has under 50 households in the tract or the rate is low reliability. Count and rate color scales are shared by all six CPAs. ",
                "The two \"50%+\" layers sort tracts by whether the overall homeownership rate and the group's rate are each 50% or more. ",
                "Focus tracts have both of those rates at 50% or more and ADU units at or above this CPA's middle tract (", fmt(adu_cut), " units or more): ",
                tr_word(n_fl), " for Latino owners (red outline) and ", tr_word(n_fb), " for Black owners (purple dashed outline). ",
                "ACS 2020–2024 5-year; ADU projects ", window_label, ", one dot per project, sized by units. ", basemap_credit, ".")),
  tags$details(style = "margin-bottom: 14px;",
               tags$summary(style = "font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer;", "Show the numbers behind the map (sorted by Latino plus Black owner households)"),
               HTML(as.character(ly_tab))))
```

### Working-class tracts

```{r}
# ---- Working-class tables -------------------------------------------------------------------
tc_cc <- tract_class %>% filter(cpa == cc)
res3 <- d3_build(tc_cc)
adu_in <- a_cc %>% filter(tract_cpa %in% cc)
prop_in <- st_drop_geometry(p_cc) %>% filter(tract_cpa %in% cc)
d4 <- d4_build(tc_cc, adu_in, prop_in)
n_left_parcels <- sum(!(st_drop_geometry(p_cc)$tract_cpa %in% cc))
n_left_units <- sum(a_cc$units[!(a_cc$tract_cpa %in% cc)]) + 0
n_wc <- sum(tc_cc$class == "Working-class"); n_oth <- sum(tc_cc$class == "Other"); n_ins <- sum(tc_cc$class == "Insufficient data")
store[[cc]] <- list(n_wc = n_wc, n_oth = n_oth, n_ins = n_ins, n_tracts = nrow(tc_cc),
                    wc_units_share = d4$units[d4$group == "Working-class, all tracts"] / sum(adu_in$units))
qa_add(7, paste0("Working-class tables built with the confirmed rule, ", cc), "tracts > 0", nrow(tc_cc), nrow(tc_cc) > 0, stop_if_fail = TRUE)
```

`r cc` has `r n_wc` working-class tracts, `r n_oth` other tracts`r if (n_ins > 0) paste0(" and ", n_ins, " with insufficient data") else ""`. `r if (n_oth == 0) "With no other tracts, the comparison columns for other tracts are empty here; the six-CPA rows under Decision points (decision 4) carry the finding." else if (n_oth < 5) paste0("With only ", n_oth, " other tract", ifelse(n_oth == 1, "", "s"), ", the comparison is thin here; the six-CPA rows under Decision points (decision 4) carry the finding.") else ""`

```{r}
d3_table(res3, caption = paste0("Demographics of working-class and other tracts, ", cc),
         note = paste("ACS 2020–2024 5-year. Group values come from counts summed over each group's tracts, never from averaging tract rates. MOE = 90% margin of error (shares in percentage points); † = low reliability.",
                      "The class describes a tract's residents, not the owner of any ADU in it."))
d4_table(d4) %>%
  tbl(caption = paste0("ADUs in working-class and other tracts, ", cc),
      note = paste0("ADU projects and lots on parcels inside the CPA whose tract is assigned to this CPA. ",
                    fmt(n_left_parcels), " parcels in the CPA lie in tracts assigned elsewhere (", fmt(n_left_units),
                    " ADU units); they count in every CPA total but not here. ", grp_note,
                    " The class describes a tract's residents, not the owner of any ADU in it."),
      align = c("l", rep("r", 4)))
```
